text:
Predicates:
InternationalStudent(x) ::: x is an international student.
InUS(x) ::: x is in the US.
F1(x) ::: x has an F1 visa.
J1(x) ::: x has a J1 visa.
WantsToWork(x) ::: x wants to work in the US.
NeedsCPTorOPT(x) ::: x needs to apply for CPT or OPT.
Mike ::: a specific individual.

Premises:
∀x (InternationalStudent(x) ∧ InUS(x) → (F1(x) ∨ J1(x))) ::: International students in the US have either an F1 visa or a J1 visa.
∀x ((InUS(x) ∧ F1(x) ∧ WantsToWork(x)) → NeedsCPTorOPT(x)) ::: An international student in US with an F1 visa who wants to work in the US needs to apply for CPT or OPT.
NeedsCPTorOPT(Mike) ::: Mike needs to apply for CPT if he wants to work in the US.

Conclusion:
J1(Mike)
